name: 12-lipoxygenase synthesis of hepoxilins and trioxilins
rationale: All members concern the 12-lipoxygenase branch of arachidonate metabolism producing 12-HETE derivatives, hepoxilins and trioxilins, unlike confusables centred on 5-/15-lipoxygenase lipoxins, leukotriene catabolism, skin barrier lipids or cornification.

qualifier: cranial neuron migration and axon guidance
name: Cranial nerve development and cranial neuron migration
rationale: Members cover development of facial, trigeminal and olfactory nerves and cranial ganglia plus branchiomotor axon guidance and hindbrain/GnRH neuron migration, whereas confusables concern craniofacial glands, inner/outer ear, or trunk peripheral and sympathetic neurons.

core: Keratinocyte and epithelial regulation in wound healing
name: Keratinocyte proliferation and migration control in wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial proliferation, migration, epidermal spreading and wound inflammation (including IL-20 family signalling), whereas confusables emphasise keratinocyte differentiation, apoptosis and RUNX1-driven programmes.

name: Lipoprotein metabolism and ABC-transporter cholesterol and phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance with sterol homeostasis, and uniquely include ABCA1/ABCG5/ABCG8/ABCB4/ABCB11 lipid efflux absent from confusables focused on vitamin E, receptor endocytosis, triglyceride catabolism or SREBP.

name: Calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle fusion in neurotransmitter exocytosis
rationale: All members concern calcium-dependent fusion of synaptic vesicles to release neurotransmitter, distinct from confusables on presynaptic calcium entry, transmitter-specific secretion, or vesicle docking and priming.

name: Transferrin-cycle iron uptake and iron homeostasis
rationale: Members cover iron import across the plasma membrane, transferrin endocytosis/recycling, DMT1 defects and iron homeostasis, while confusables add heme scavenging or oxygen-sensing/redox responses instead of the transferrin route.

qualifier: regulation of protein import and export, coronavirus-targeted
name: Regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein import and export
rationale: Members regulate nuclear import and export of protein cargo, including NLS import and SARS-CoV host targeting, unlike confusables on nuclear pore structure and RNA/ribosome export, viral protein maturation, or senescence/GTPase regulation.

name: Response to environmental toxicants: pesticides, dioxin, heavy metals
rationale: Members are responses to pesticides, dioxin via the aryl hydrocarbon receptor, heavy metals and endocrine disruptors, whereas confusables concern vitamins C/E, heme oxygenase/redox, or ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics.

core: Bone remodeling by osteoblasts and osteoclasts
name: Wnt-modulated osteoblast and osteoclast regulation of bone remodeling
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast/mesenchymal stem cell and osteoclast proliferation and differentiation, mineralization and resorption together with Wnt signalling and its antagonists, which confusables focused on IGF/phosphate, TGF-beta/BMP or tendon and trabecula formation lack.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of long, medium and branched-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members describe acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very long, long, medium and branched (pristanoyl) chains, distinct from confusables on ABCD1/peroxisome maintenance, alpha-oxidation or short-chain catabolism.

name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis activating Notch and ERBB4 signalling
rationale: Members concern proteolytic processing that releases Notch1-4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains to the nucleus, upstream of the NICD-driven transcription in C1 and unrelated to the Wnt and Hedgehog confusables.

name: Hindbrain and brainstem development, including respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain, pons and brainstem development and maturation with neural control of respiration, while confusables concern cranial nerves, spinal cord patterning or cerebellar development.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment
rationale: Members involve formyl peptide GPCRs driving granulocyte/neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment, whereas confusables concern macrophage chemokines, diapedesis/negative migration control, or neutrophil degranulation and complement.

core: Drug absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion
name: Drug disposition and glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are drug ADME routes (aspirin, paracetamol, prednisone, ciprofloxacin, atorvastatin, CYP2E1) and mitochondrial amino acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing them from acetylation/methylation, sulfonation or amino acid metabolism confusables.

core: SLC solute transport across the plasma membrane
qualifier: neutral amino acids, peptides and urate
name: SLC transport of neutral amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane carriers and their disease variants for neutral amino acids, cystine, oligopeptides and urate, distinct from confusables on organic cation transport, cationic amino acids/ornithine or hexose absorption.

qualifier: biosynthesis, transport and catabolism rather than receptor signalling
name: Leukotriene biosynthesis, transport and catabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene and eoxin synthesis, leukotriene transport and leukotriene/icosanoid catabolism, unlike confusables on leukotriene/prostanoid receptor signalling, lipoxins or cytochrome P450 HETE/EET pathways.

core: Motile cilium and flagellum assembly and motility
qualifier: left-right patterning and ciliary fluid flow
name: Motile cilia and sperm flagella: assembly, beating, left-right patterning
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein and central apparatus assembly, multiciliogenesis, sperm flagellar motility, nodal left-right asymmetry, CSF circulation and mucociliary clearance, whereas confusables centre on intraflagellar transport and primary (non-motile) cilia.

name: Iron homeostasis linked to oxygen sensing and redox responses
rationale: Members combine iron import and homeostasis with oxygen detection, superoxide removal and selenium response, which distinguishes them from confusables built on transferrin cycling, heme scavenging or vitamin C.

core: Membrane transport of gases and small metabolites
qualifier: erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, Rh ammonium and lactate
name: Membrane transport of respiratory gases, ammonium and lactate
rationale: Members cover erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, NO transport, Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport and proton-coupled monocarboxylate/basigin lactate transport, unlike confusables on heme/iron metabolism or lung surfactant.

name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA dehydrogenase beta-oxidation chain-shortening cycles
rationale: Members are the stepwise mitochondrial beta-oxidation cycles from palmitoyl- to acetyl-CoA via acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, distinct from confusables on carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies, or peroxisomal and alpha-oxidation.

name: G2/M transition and checkpoint control of cyclin B-CDK1
rationale: Members describe G2 phase, cyclin A/B events and Chk1/Chk2 checkpoint inactivation of cyclin B-CDK1, unlike confusables on p53 DNA-damage signalling, E2F-driven G1/S or T-cell proliferation.

qualifier: cell lineage hierarchy from stem cells
name: Mammary gland epithelial cell lineage specification
rationale: All members trace developmental lineages of mammary stem, luminal, alveolar and myoepithelial cells, whereas confusables cover mammary morphogenesis and lactation or prostate and reproductive tract development.

qualifier: peroxisome fission, protein processing and ABCD1 import
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA beta-oxidation and organelle upkeep
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal VLCFA and acyl-CoA oxidation with ABCD1 substrate import, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome fission, which confusables on branched-chain catabolism, alpha-oxidation or peroxisomal protein import lack.

name: SLC4 and SLC26 bicarbonate and inorganic anion exchange
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, sulfate, oxalate, iodide and chloride transport by SLC4/SLC26 exchangers and their diseases, distinct from confusables on CFTR, cation-chloride cotransporters, carbonic anhydrase or mineralization transporters.

name: Cardiac intercalated disc desmosome assembly and cardiomyocyte adhesion
rationale: Members cover desmosome and intermediate filament assembly, junctional protein localization, cardiomyocyte adhesion and ventricular action potential, unlike confusables on sarcomere contraction, costamere/T-tubule, gap junctions or hemidesmosomes.
